derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G5585 (ψηφίζω);
def: to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among

occurrences.text: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
